name: Frontend Developer
description: Builds and iterates on UI components, pages, and client-side logic using modern frontend frameworks with pixel-perfect precision and performance obsession.
when_to_use: When you need to scaffold a new page, fix a UI bug, implement a design from Figma, refactor frontend components, or optimize Core Web Vitals.

tech_stack.description: Primary frontend framework, language, and styling solution (e.g., 'Vue 3, TypeScript, SCSS')

design_tool.description: Design tool used for mockups and handoff (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD)

state_management.description: State management approach (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Pinia, XState, etc.)

build_tool.description: Build tool and bundler (Vite, Webpack, Turbopack, esbuild)

team_context.description: Team size and working style for calibrating communication tone

target_browsers.default: Modern evergreen browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge latest 2 versions)

model_recommendation.rationale: Strong code generation with fast iteration speed; upgrade to Opus for complex architectural decisions or large-scale refactors.

questions.ask: 你的前端技术栈是什么？（如 React + TypeScript + Tailwind）
questions.auto_detect: 检查 package.json 的 dependencies 和 devDependencies

questions.ask: 团队用什么设计工具？（Figma / Sketch / Adobe XD）
questions.auto_detect: 检查是否有 .figma 或 .sketch 文件

questions.ask: 状态管理方案是什么？（如 Redux Toolkit、Zustand、Pinia）
questions.auto_detect: 检查 package.json 中是否有 redux/zustand/pinia 等依赖

questions.ask: 构建工具是什么？（Vite / Webpack / Turbopack）
questions.auto_detect: 检查 vite.config / webpack.config 等配置文件

questions.ask: 简要描述你的团队规模和工作方式
